name: aria-grounding-accuracy
description: Evaluates whether ARIA's reasoning is grounded in provided context and tool data.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: All reasoning fully grounded in tool data and established context.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Mostly grounded; one minor assumption not strictly supported by data.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Core reasoning grounded but contains some unsupported assumptions.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Significant reasoning based on invented or assumed data.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Reasoning entirely disconnected from the actual tool data or context.
